name: Unbridled: An Untameable Story
source:
After running away from your old life in the city, you find yourself in a place you never expected... with people you never could have imagined.

[From [url=https://choices-stories-you-play.fandom.com/wiki/Unbridled:_An_Untameable_Story]Choices Wikia[/url]]
